title: Searchable change log with topic icons
summary: The Change Log now loads from a JSON file, shows topic icons for each entry, and can be searched or filtered by topic.

title: Examples project, module guide, and cleaner Generate
summary: The project selector now includes a special Examples project with starter sketches across modules. The guide now speaks in Modules instead of API families, and Generate now creates a new revision with a cleaned definition, a better sketch name, and no AI-made circuit layout.

title: Change log added to the guide
summary: The guide now has a Change Log page for short notes about visible web changes and firmware deploys.
